cases.sentence: Но у меня есть ум, как и у ___.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at, with) governs the genitive case to show possession.
The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.
The preposition всему (to all) requires the dative case.
The preposition над (above/over) governs the instrumental case.
The transitive verb лишает (deprives) takes a direct object in the accusative case.
The preposition руках (hands) requires the genitive case.
The preposition у (from/away) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Но спроси у животных, они научат ___.
cases.explain: The transitive verb научат (will teach) takes the direct object in the accusative case.

reading.ru: Но у меня есть ум, как и у вас.
reading.question: What does Job claim to possess equally with his friends?
reading.explain: Job states Но у меня есть ум, как и у вас — 'But I have understanding as well as you.'

reading.ru: Я стал для друзей посмешищем, а ведь я к Богу взывал, и Он мне отвечал.
reading.question: Despite being mocked by his friends, what does Job say he did?
options: He called on God and God answered him
reading.correct: He called on God and God answered him
reading.explain: The sentence explicitly states that Job called upon God (я к Богу взывал) and God answered him (Он мне отвечал).

reading.ru: Кто среди них не знает, что все это сделала рука Господня?
reading.question: According to Job, whose hand has done all these things?
reading.explain: The text asks Кто не знает, что все это сделала рука Господня — 'Who doesn't know that the hand of the Lord has done all this.'

reading.ru: Разве не ухо различает слова, и не язык распознает вкус пищи?
reading.question: What does Job compare the ear and tongue to?
options: Tools for distinguishing between good and bad things
reading.correct: Tools for distinguishing between good and bad things
reading.explain: The rhetorical question implies that ears distinguish words and tongues distinguish taste, showing that humans have perception and wisdom.

reading.ru: Он лишает речи искусных советников и отбирает разум у старцев.
reading.question: What does God do to wise counselors and elders?
options: He deprives them of speech and takes away their understanding
reading.correct: He deprives them of speech and takes away their understanding
reading.explain: The text states Он лишает речи искусных советников и отбирает разум у старцев — 'He deprives wise counselors of speech and takes understanding from elders.'

reading.ru: Бредят они на ощупь в темноте, без света, и шатаются, словно пьяные.
reading.question: How does Job describe the fate of those whom God turns away?
options: They grope in darkness without light and stagger like drunk men
reading.correct: They grope in darkness without light and stagger like drunk men
reading.explain: The concluding sentence shows that Бредят они на ощупь в темноте, без света, и шатаются, словно пьяные — they wander in darkness helplessly.
